entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Some crazy stuff is going on[n]with the Phantom Thieves!

entries.en: It's chaos over here because[n]of the Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You're still alive, so you must[n]be scheming something, right!?

entries.en: I gotta prepare myself for[n]one more mountain.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: But I'm glad you're OK. I'm busy,[n]so I'll talk to you again later.
